const ll MOD = 998244353;

class FFT {
public:
    class FastScanner {
    private:
        istream* in;
        string buffer;
        size_t pos;

    public:
        FastScanner(istream& is) : in(&is), buffer(""), pos(0) {}
        
        string nextLine() {
            string line;
            if (getline(*in, line)) {
                return line;
            }
            return "";
        }
        
        string next() {
            while (true) {
                if (buffer.size() <= pos) {
                    if (!getline(*in, buffer)) return "";
                    pos = 0;
                }
                while (pos < buffer.size() && isspace(buffer[pos])) pos++;
                if (pos >= buffer.size()) continue;
                size_t start = pos;
                while (pos < buffer.size() && !isspace(buffer[pos])) pos++;
                return buffer.substr(start, pos - start);
            }
        }
        
        int nextInt() {
            return stoi(next());
        }
        
        long long nextLong() {
            return stoll(next());
        }
        
        double nextDouble() {
            return stod(next());
        }
    };

    class Vector {
    public:
        int sz = 1 << 20;
        vector<long long> v;
        
        Vector(vector<long long> a) {
            v.resize(sz, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
                v[i] = a[i];
            }
        }
        
        vector<long long> FFT() {
            return DFT(0, 1, true);
        }
        
        vector<long long> FFT1() {
            vector<long long> x = DFT(0, 1, false);
            for (int i = 0; i < x.size(); i++) {
                x[i] = x[i] * szinv % mod;
            }
            return x;
        }
        
        vector<long long> DFT(int first, int pow_val, bool straight) {
            if (pow_val == sz) {
                vector<long long> ans = {v[first]};
                return ans;
            }
            vector<long long> zero = DFT(first, 2 * pow_val, straight);
            vector<long long> one = DFT(first + pow_val, 2 * pow_val, straight);
            int n = zero.size();
            vector<long long> ans(2 * n, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                ans[i] = (zero[i] + (straight ? warr[i * pow_val] : winvarr[i * pow_val]) * one[i]) % mod;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                ans[n + i] = (((zero[i] - (straight ? warr[i * pow_val] : winvarr[i * pow_val]) * one[i]) % mod) + mod) % mod;
            }
            return ans;
        }
    };
    
    vector<long long> fft(vector<long long> a) {
        long long wth = 1;
        int sz = 1 << 20;
        vector<long long> ans(sz, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < ans.size(); i++) {
            long long x = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < a.size(); j++) {
                ans[i] += a[j] * x;
                ans[i] %= MOD;
                x *= wth;
                x %= MOD;
            }
            wth *= w;
            wth %= MOD;
        }
        return ans;
    }
    
    vector<long long> pow(vector<long long> ans, int p) {
        for (int i = 0; i < ans.size(); i++) {
            ans[i] = myPow(ans[i], p);
        }
        return ans;
    }
    
    long long myPow(long long x, int p) {
        if (p == 0) {
            return 1;
        }
        if (p % 2 == 1) {
            return myPow(x, p - 1) * x % MOD;
        }
        long long y = myPow(x, p / 2);
        return y * y % MOD;
    }
    
    long long mod = MOD;
    long long w = 646;
    long long winv;
    vector<long long> warr;
    vector<long long> winvarr;
    long long szinv;
    
    FFT() {
        // Calculate modular inverse using extended Euclidean algorithm
        winv = modInverse(w, mod);
        szinv = modInverse(1 << 20, mod);
        
        warr.resize(1 << 20);
        winvarr.resize(1 << 20);
        warr[0] = 1;
        winvarr[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < warr.size(); i++) {
            warr[i] = warr[i - 1] * w % mod;
            winvarr[i] = winvarr[i - 1] * winv % mod;
        }
    }
    
    long long modInverse(long long a, long long m) {
        long long m0 = m, y = 0, x = 1;
        if (m == 1) return 0;
        while (a > 1) {
            long long q = a / m;
            long long t = m;
            m = a % m;
            a = t;
            t = y;
            y = x - q * y;
            x = t;
        }
        if (x < 0) x += m0;
        return x;
    }
    
    void solve() {
        int n, k;
        cin >> n >> k;
        vector<long long> arr(10, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {

        for (int i = 0; i < x.size(); i++) {

            ans %= mod;
        }
        cout << ans << endl;
    }

    void run() {
